latHint: Think the code word that starts it all - not a cheer.
pivHint: BRAVO! is the opera crowd's cheer - but in the radio code, B is BRAVO, and what word stands for A?
winText: Roger. BRAVO was the pivot - an opera cheer to the code word ALPHA.
lossText: ALPHA - code word for A. BRAVO was the pivot: an opera cry to the code word before it, ALPHA.
